subject: Resizing plots saved as png from ggplot in RStudio

messages.author: 09e8e9ef7de769f3
messages.subject: Resizing plots saved as png from ggplot in RStudio
parts:
Hello,

I am using RStudio (excellent!) to produce HTML reports, including plots generated with ggplot (excellent!).  I need to reuse the png figure files in a separate slide presentation.  By default, the plots are square. 

The plots shown in the RStudio plot tab are automatically resized.  How do I modify the shape and size of plots exported by ggplot?

Best,
Wacek

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Resizing plots saved as png from ggplot in RStudio

messages.author: 1aeacfceb4e2c6d5
messages.subject: Re: Resizing plots saved as png from ggplot in RStudio
parts:
Hi Wacek

In RStudio, directly in the 'Plots' Tab, you've got the dropdown menu 'Export' with 'Save plot as Image'
In the subsequently opening separate window you can, among other things, directly set width & height.

cheers
Georg
